instruction: The file sales.csv has columns order_id,region,product,month,units,price (240 rows). Which region had the highest total number of units sold in months 1 through 6 inclusive? Answer with the region name. Use bash with python3 to compute it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
